examples.text: nhatvā ca pivitvā c'udatāri satthā, purakkhato bhikkhugaṇassa majjhe, satthā pavattā bhagavā idha dhamme, upāgami ambavanaṃ mahesi, āmantayi cundakaṃ nāma bhikkhuṃ, catugguṇaṃ santhara me nipajjaṃ.
ubbiggā tasitā bhītā, bhantā byāthitamānasā, mahājanā samāgamma, dīpaṅ'karam'upāgamuṃ.

16301.meaning2: approaching; having entered upon; beings subject to

16302.commentary: (DNa) vasūnaṃ vāsavo seṭṭho, sakk'opāgā purin'dado'ti vasūnaṃ devatānaṃ seṭṭho vāsavo yo sakko'ti ca, purin'dado'ti ca vuccati, so'pi āgato.

examples.text: vasūnaṃ vāsavo seṭṭho, sakko-upāgā purin'dado, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.

16306.meaning1: fallen into the power (of); prey (to); addicted (to)
16306.meaning2: fallen into the power of, prey to (plus locative.)

examples.text: ye ve na taṇhāsu upātipannā, vitareyya oghaṃ amamā caranti, kālena tesu habyaṃ pavecche, yo brāhmaṇo puññapekkho yajetha.
samitāvi pahāya puññapāpaṃ, virajo ñatvā imaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ, jātimaraṇaṃ upātivatto, samaṇo tādi pavuccate tath'attā.
na brāhmaṇassa paraneyyam'atthi, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, tasmā vivādāni upātivatto, na hi seṭṭhato passati dhammam'aññaṃ.
sace kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattissasi, seyyathā'pi nāma puriso siriṃ āgacchantiṃ daṇḍena paṭippaṇāmeyya… evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, tuyhaṃ bhavissati.
na maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, hit'ānukampī evaṃ vadesi, ahit'ānukampī maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, evaṃ vadesi. tuyhañ'hi, pāpima, evaṃ hoti, yesaṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desessati, te me visayaṃ upātivattissantī'ti.
taṃ t'āhaṃ, bhikkhu, evaṃ vadāmi, iṅgha tvaṃ, mārisa, yadeva te brahmā āha tadeva tvaṃ karohi, mā tvaṃ brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattittho.

16313.grammar: ger of upādiyati, irreg form of upādāya, trans (+acc)
16313.meaning1: holding (on); grasping (on); attaching; clinging; taking possession (of)

examples.text: laddhā hi so upādānaṃ, mahā hutvāna pāvako, so āsajja ḍahe bālaṃ, naraṃ nāriñ'ca ekadā.
yasmiṃ kho, vaccha, samaye acci vātena khittā dūram'pi gacchati, tam'ahaṃ vāta-upādānaṃ paññāpemi. vāto hi'ssa, vaccha, tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotī'ti.

16316.meaning1: grasping; clinging; acquiring; appropriating; taking possession; identifying
16316.commentary: (SNa) upādānan'ti daḷhaggahaṇaṃ vuccati. daḷh'attho hi ettha upasaddo upāyāsaupakaṭṭh'ādīsu viya. pañcakāmaguṇikarāgass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. ayam'ettha saṅkhepo.

examples.text: pañcasu kho, nāgita, upādānakkhandhesu udayabbay'ānupassino viharato upādāne pāṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti, eso tassa nissando'ti.
upādāniye ca, bhikkhave, dhamme desessāmi upādānañ'ca. taṃ suṇātha. katame ca, bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, katamaṃ upādānaṃ?
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māṇava, yaṃ vā tiṇakaṭṭh'upādānaṃ paṭicca aggiṃ jāleyya yaṃ vā nissaṭṭhatiṇakaṭṭh'upādānaṃ aggiṃ jāleyya, katamo nu khv'āssa aggi accimā c'eva vaṇṇavā ca pabhassaro cā'ti?

16318.meaning1: aggregates that are clung to; physical and mental conglomerations that are held onto as a self
16318.commentary: (KHPa) pañcā'ti gaṇanaparicchedo. upādānajanitā upādānajanakā vā khandhā upādānakkhandhā. yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ, vedanā, saññā, saṅkhārā, viññāṇañ'ca sāsavā upādāniyā, etesam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, evañ'hi kira imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ saṅgaho sannipāto samavāyo hoti.
pañcasu kho pana upādānakkhandhesu udayabbay'ānupassī viharati, iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅ'gamo. iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthaṅ'gamo.

16319.meaningLit: discourse on aggregates that are clung to

16321.meaning1: wearing away of grasping; ending of clinging; extinction of attachment

so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti, pavivek'ādhimutto hoti, abyāpajj'ādhimutto hoti, taṇhākkhay'ādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhay'ādhimutto hoti, asammoh'ādhimutto hoti.

16322.meaning1: habituated to the destruction of ownership; established in the destruction of possession; firmly entrenched in extinction of attachment

sace maṃ, bhante, evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, bhavo pan'āvuso ānanda, kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo'ti? evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, bhavo kho, āvuso, upādānanidāno upādānasamudayo upādānajātiko upādānappabhavo'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.

tassa me upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā nirujjhanti, evam'etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī'ti.

16340.meaning1: highest thing to grasp; ultimate acquisition
16340.commentary: (MNa) upādānaseṭṭhaṃ kira so, bhante'ti, bhante, so kira bhikkhu gahetabbaṭṭhānaṃ seṭṭhaṃ uttamaṃ bhavaṃ upādiyati, seṭṭhabhave paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhātī'ti attho. iminā tassa bhikkhuno paṭisandhi kathitā. (MNt) ten'āha bhagavā, dhammā'pi kho, bhikkhave, pahātabbā, pag'eva adhammā'ti (ma. ni. 1.240). upādānaseṭṭhan'ti idaṃ n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-bhavassa sabbabhav'aggatādassanaparaṃ, na pana ariyabhav'aggassa upādānaseṭṭhatā-paṭisedhaparaṃ.

examples.text: upādānaseṭṭhaṃ kira so, bhante, bhikkhu upādiyamāno upādiyatī'ti? upādānaseṭṭhañ'hi so, ānanda, bhikkhu upādiyamāno upādiyati.

16341.meaning1: enjoying grasping; taking pleasure in acquisition

examples.text: upādān'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, upādānaratassa upādānasammuditassa, upādānanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

examples.text: rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, upādāniyo dhammo, yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, upādāniyesu dhammesu ādīnav'ānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.

16345.meaningLit: discourse on what can be clung to

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

16348.meaning1: agitation through clinging; anxiety through attachment

16350.meaning1: taking; taking up; grasping (onto); taking possession (of)

examples.text: puṇṇo nāma, āvuso, āyasmā mantāṇiputto amhākaṃ navakānaṃ sataṃ bah'ūpakāro hoti. so amhe iminā ovādena ovadati, upādāya, āvuso ānanda, asmī'ti hoti, no anupādāya.
yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.

chasu loko samuppanno, chasu kubbati santhavaṃ, channam'eva upādāya, chasu loko vihaññatī'ti.

16361.meaning1: grasped; clung to; attached to; taken as mine; taken possession of

examples.text: so rūpaṃ viññāṇaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti attā me'ti. tass'ime pañc'upādānakkhandhā upetā upādinnā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.

16364.meaning1: place where the continuity that is grasped occurs
16364.commentary: (DNt) upādinnakasantati-pavattiṭṭhāne'ti kammajarūpasantatiyā pavattiṭṭhāne aphuṭaṃ nāma na hotī'ti sambandho.

examples.text: sabbāvato kāyassā'ti assa bhikkhuno sabbakoṭṭhāsavato kāyassa kiñci upādinnakasantati-pavattiṭṭhāne chavimaṃsalohit'ānugataṃ aṇumattam'pi ṭhānaṃ paṭhamajjhānasukhena aphuṭaṃ nāma na hoti.

16365.commentary: (ANa) na kiñci loke upādiyatī'ti kiñci ekam'pi saṅkhāragataṃ taṇhāvasena na upādiyati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati.
16365.notes: passive in form, active in meaning.

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, ettāvatā saupavajjo'ti vadāmi. yo kho, sāriputta, tañ'ca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, aññañ'ca kāyaṃ upādiyati, tam'ahaṃ saupavajjo'ti vadāmi.
so evaṃ asamanupassanto na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.
anissito na calati, nissito ca upādiyaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.
taṃ, bhikkhave, attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyetha, yaṃsa attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

16367.notes: passive in form, active in meaning.

examples.text: sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam'ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto vihareyyan'ti. upādiyamāno kho, bhikkhu, baddho mārassa, anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato'ti.
ahañ'hi rūpaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, vedanaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saññaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saṅkhāreyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, viññāṇaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ.
bhav'ev'āhaṃ bhayaṃ disvā, bhavañ'ca vibhav'esinaṃ, bhavaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ kiñci, nandiñ'ca na upādiyin'ti.
ahañ'hi rūpaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, vedanaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saññaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saṅkhāreyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, viññāṇaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ.

16370.meaning1: having grabbed hold of; having grasped (something with)
16370.meaning2: having grasped hold (of); having clung (to); having taken possession (of)

examples.text: so antaraghare nisinno samāno na hatthakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na pādakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na adduvena adduvaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca pāṇinā hanukaṃ upādiyitvā nisīdati.

16371.meaning1: remnant of grasping; remaining fuel of existence
16371.meaning2: having some fuel of life left, still dependent on existence

examples.text: evaṃ sammā dvayat'ānupassino kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā'ti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bahū ce'pi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti, na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati

16373.synonym: ñāya, niyāma, nīhāra, pakāra, patha, pariyāya, magga, vidhi

examples.text: upāyakusalen'āhaṃ, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā yoniso paṭipajjitvā, bhave cittaṃ udabbahin'ti.
evaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ karuṇāyitvā tato paraṃ eten'eva upāyena piyapuggale, tato majjhatte, tato verimhī'ti anukkamena karuṇā pavattetabbā.

viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikan'ti viditvā ye viññāṇe upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.

16376.meaning1: skilful in ways; adept in methods

examples.text: upāyakusalena-ahaṃ, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā yoniso paṭipajjitvā, bhave cittaṃ udabbahin'ti.

16377.meaning1: skill in means; expertise in expedient methods
16377.meaning2: skill in means; skill in expedience

examples.text: tīṇi kosallāni, āyakosallaṃ, apāyakosallaṃ, upāyakosallaṃ.

16378.meaning2: knowing the means, knowing the way

examples.text: yathā, mahārāja, puriso rañño cakkavattissa madhuṃ vā madhupiṇḍikaṃ vā aññaṃ vā upāyanaṃ abhihareyya, tam'enaṃ rañño dvārapālo evaṃ vadeyya akālo, bho, ayaṃ rañño dassanāya, tena hi, bho, tava upāyanaṃ gahetvā sīghasīghaṃ paṭinivatta, pure tava rājā daṇḍaṃ dhāressatī'ti.
upāyanañ'ca te deva, n'āññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ, sabbasākuṇikāgāme, taṃ passa manuj'ādhipa.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti

16381.meaning1: full of difficulty; very afflicted; greatly troubled

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

16383.construction:
upa + ā + √yas > yās + *ita + tta
upāyāsita + tta

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, upāyāso? yo kho, bhikkhave, aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, upāyāso

16384.meaning1: engagement and grasping; attraction and acquiring
16384.commentary: (SNa) upay'upādānā'ti taṇh'ūpaya-diṭṭh'ūpayavasena dve upayā, kām'upādān'ādīni cattāri upādānāni ca.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapati, anokasārī hoti? rūpadhātuyā kho, gahapati, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye upāy'upādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. tasmā tathāgato anokasārī'ti vuccati.

16385.meaning1: attached to engaging, grasping and clinging; shackled to going near, grabbing and holding
16385.compound: dvanda (upāya ca upādāna ca abhinivesa ca vinibandha ca)
16385.commentary: (SNa) upay'upādān'ābhinivesa-vinibandho'ti upayehi ca upādānehi ca abhinivesehi ca vinibandho. tattha upayā'ti dve upayā taṇh'upayo ca diṭṭh'upayo ca. upādān'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: upāy'upādān'ābhinivesa-vinibandho khv'āyaṃ, kaccāna, loko yebhuyyena. tañ'c'āyaṃ upay'upādānaṃ cetaso adhiṭṭhānaṃ abhinives'ānusayaṃ na upeti na upādiyati n'ādhiṭṭhāti, attā me'ti.

16386.meaning1: engaging and grasping; approaching and clinging; going near and grabbing hold

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikan'ti viditvā ye viññāṇe upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.

16387.meaning2: skillfully; in the right way; by a stratagem

16389.commentary: (MNa) nindā-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti attano nindābhayena ghaṭṭanabhayena upavādabhayena cā'ti attho. (SNa) nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti viññūnaṃ santikā nindābhayena ca ghaṭṭanabhayena ca dos'āropanabhayena ca upārambhabhayena ca.

examples.text: te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti.
upārambhaṃ na sikkheyya, khalitañ'ca na gāhaye, n'ābhihare n'ābhimadde, na vācaṃ payutaṃ bhaṇe.

16390.meaning1: with a fault-finding mind; with a critical attitude

examples.text: makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.

16391.meaning1: criticizes; finds fault; challenges; refutes; confutes (with)

examples.text: nanu, mālukyaputta, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇ'ūpamena upārambhena upārambhissanti? daharassa hi, mālukyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sakkāyo'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pan'assa uppajjissati sakkāyadiṭṭhi?

16392.meaning1: for the purpose of debating; for the sake of argument
16392.commentary: (MNa) te upārambh'ānisaṃsā cevā'ti te paresaṃ vāde dos'āropan'ānisaṃsā hutvā pariyāpuṇantī'ti attho. (SNa) upārambh'ānisaṃsan'ti ayaṃ pucchāya doso, ayaṃ vissajjane'ti evaṃ vādados'ānisaṃsaṃ.

examples.text: te upārambh'ānisaṃsā c'eva dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsā ca. yassa c'atthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañ'c'assa atthaṃ n'ānubhonti.
aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, tapassi, anavakāso yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya. ṭhānañ'ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo gotamo upālissa gahapatissa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya.

16394.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk of those learned in the Vinaya
16394.commentary: (ANa) vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ upālī'ti vinayadharānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ upālitthero aggo'ti dasseti. thero kira tathāgatass'eva santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tathāgatass'eva santike vinayapiṭakaṃ uggaṇhitvā bhārukacchakavatthuṃ, ajjukavatthuṃ, (pārā. 158) kumārakassapavatthun'ti imāni tīṇi vatthūni sabbaññutaññāṇena saddhiṃ saṃsandetvā kathesi. tasmā vinayadharānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.
16394.notes: Theragāthā verses 249-251 (TH3.11, TH180) are attributed to him.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ upāli

16398.commentary: (MNa) upālipamukhāyā'ti upālijeṭṭhakāya… upālipamukhāyā'ti upāligahapati'y'eva tattha thokaṃ sappañño, so tassā pamukho jeṭṭhako. tenā'pi vuttaṃ upālipamukhāyā'ti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto mahatiyā gihiparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti bālakiniyā parisāya upālipamukhāya.
